metadata.title: Transport Management and Freight Exchange Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to shipper, carrier, and site web applications, the carrier mobile app, public API / EDI / telematics gateways, and the internal network operations backoffice. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: Browser-based workspaces for shippers, carriers, forwarders, and site teams, one sub-channel per major web application.
The enterprise shipper workspace covering the full Plan, Execute, Track, Settle, and Analyse lifecycle for transport planners and transportation directors.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Transport order UI and backing services deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: The system of record for every transport order a planner creates, tenders, and follows to delivery.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Planning and optimization UI and backing services deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Turns ERP order intake into an optimized, tendable load plan for plants and DCs.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Carrier selection and tendering UI and backing services deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Runs routing-guide, cascade, and spot tendering so every load reaches the right contracted or spot carrier.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Freight cost UI and backing services deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Keeps expected cost per shipment visible from planning through settlement against contracted rates.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Freight audit and self-billing UI and backing services deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Makes audited invoices and self-billing a standard attach to the execution flow.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Visibility map, ETA, and tracking UI deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Gives planners live position and ETA on every dispatched order without calling the carrier.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Exception worklist and resolution UI deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Surfaces late, at-risk, and disrupted shipments as a prioritized worklist planners resolve before customers notice.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Analytics dashboards and reporting UI deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Delivers cost, service, and lane-benchmark insight to transportation directors.
Embeds operational cost and service reporting inside the planner and director workspace.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Emissions and CSRD reporting UI deployed to the shipper TMS web application.

usedInProducts.description: Turns executed transport data into CO2 and CSRD-ready emissions reporting per lane, carrier, and period.

channels.description: The tendering workspace where transportation directors run RFPs and RFQs, compare rates, and turn awards into rate cards and routing guides.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: RFP/RFQ authoring, bidding, and award UI deployed to the procurement web application.

usedInProducts.description: Runs the yearly and spot tender events that secure capacity at target cost.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Rate card and contract management UI deployed to the procurement web application.

usedInProducts.description: Turns tender awards into maintained rate cards and routing guides.
Feeds contracted rates into carrier selection and freight cost control in the TMS.

channels.description: The pan-European spot marketplace where carriers, owner-operators, and forwarders post freight and capacity, search, and close deals.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Marketplace posting, search, and deal-closing UI and backing services deployed to the exchange web application.

usedInProducts.description: The core marketplace surface for hundreds of thousands of daily freight and capacity offers.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Matching and recommendation services surfaced in exchange search results and alerts.

usedInProducts.description: Ranks and recommends the loads and trucks most likely to close, cutting time to find a load.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Trust badges, counterparty scores, and fraud warnings embedded in the exchange web experience.

usedInProducts.description: Shows every member a vetted counterparty picture before they commit a load or a truck.

channels.description: The carrier dispatch-office workspace for managing assigned transport orders, documents, and network membership from a browser.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Carrier web portal UI and backing services for order acceptance, execution, and account management.

usedInProducts.description: The dispatcher-facing browser workspace for accepting and executing shipper orders.
Lets exchange members manage their profile, fleet, and booked deals in one place.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Electronic transport document upload, signing, and archive UI deployed to the carrier portal.

usedInProducts.description: Gives back-office staff a browser view of eCMRs and PODs captured in the field.

channels.description: The site workspace where dock managers publish slot capacity and carriers book, reschedule, and check in.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Slot booking calendar, site configuration, and yard status UI deployed to the dock scheduling web application.

usedInProducts.description: The core slot booking and yard coordination surface for sites and their carriers.
Links confirmed transport orders to booked dock slots so planning and sites stay in sync.

channels.description: Mobile app store distribution for the carrier and driver app, shipped to both iOS and Android.
The driver and small-carrier app distributed through the iOS App Store and Android Play Store: execute orders, capture documents, share position, and find return loads.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Mobile app build distributed through the iOS and Android app stores.

usedInProducts.description: The in-cab surface for accepting, executing, and closing out transport orders.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Mobile document capture (eCMR signing, POD photo) embedded in the carrier app.

usedInProducts.description: Captures signed eCMRs and proof of delivery at the dock, feeding settlement without paper.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: In-app position sharing and tracking consent embedded in the carrier app.

usedInProducts.description: Turns the driver's phone into a tracking source when no telematics unit is connected.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Return-load recommendations and alerts embedded in the carrier app.

usedInProducts.description: Pushes matched return loads to drivers and owner-operators before they drive home empty.

channels.description: Machine-to-machine channels: the public REST API for shipper systems, the EDI gateway for ERP/TMS document exchange, and the telematics gateway for tracking data.
The documented public REST API through which shipper ERP, TMS, and planning systems create orders, trigger execution, and receive status callbacks at thousands of loads per day.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Execution orchestration endpoints and callback services exposed on the public REST API.

usedInProducts.description: The API-first core that takes a load from a shipper system to an accepted, dispatched carrier order.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Carrier-side API connectivity exposed on the public REST API for digitally connected carriers.

usedInProducts.description: Lets connected carriers receive, accept, and status orders system-to-system.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Transport order create/read/update endpoints exposed on the public REST API.

usedInProducts.description: Gives shipper systems direct order lifecycle access without a planner UI.
Supports API-driven order intake alongside the TMS web workspace.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: OAuth token, organization, and API-credential services backing all public API access.

usedInProducts.description: Authenticates and scopes every shipper and carrier system calling the API.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Webhook delivery and event notification services exposed alongside the public REST API.

usedInProducts.description: Delivers order status and exception events back to shipper systems as webhooks.
Powers deal, message, and alert notifications across exchange members.

channels.description: Classic EDI and file-based document exchange (orders, status, invoices) with shipper ERPs and carrier TMSs that are not REST-capable.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: EDI message translation and routing for carrier order and status documents.

usedInProducts.description: Connects EDI-only carriers to the same execution flow as API-connected ones.
Keeps legacy carrier EDI links working inside the TMS tendering and status flow.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: ERP connectors, mappings, and file-exchange services deployed behind the EDI gateway.

usedInProducts.description: Moves orders, statuses, and invoices between shipper ERPs and the TMS without rip-and-replace.
Imports lane volumes and exports awarded rates to shipper systems.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Location, product, and partner master-data synchronization services behind the EDI gateway.

usedInProducts.description: Keeps locations, loading points, and partner references consistent across every integrated system.
Supplies the site and loading-point master data slot calendars are built on.

channels.description: Ingestion channel for truck telematics and FMS providers streaming position and status data into the network.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Telematics provider adapters and consent handling deployed to the telematics gateway.

usedInProducts.description: Links each dispatched order to the assigned truck's telematics feed.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Position ingestion, tracking-event processing, and ETA computation deployed behind the telematics gateway.

usedInProducts.description: Converts raw telematics positions into shipment-level tracking and ETAs for planners.
Feeds executed-trip data into service-level and lane analytics.

channels.description: Internal backoffice tooling for network administration, trust and vetting operations, payment protection, and commercial administration.
The internal workspace where network operations teams vet carriers, run fraud and payment cases, and administer subscriptions and organizations.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Vetting case management, document checks, and compliance monitoring UI for network operations staff.

usedInProducts.description: Keeps the exchange a vetted network by screening every carrier before and during membership.
Ensures only compliant carriers receive enterprise shipper loads through the network.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Guarantee underwriting, claims, and collections case UI for network operations staff.

usedInProducts.description: Backs exchange deals with payment guarantees and runs collections when payers default.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Subscription, membership, and usage billing administration UI and services.

usedInProducts.description: Bills exchange memberships and transaction services across the carrier network.
Manages SaaS subscription and usage invoicing for enterprise shipper accounts.

deployedBricks.deploymentRole: Organization, user, and entitlement administration UI for support and network operations staff.

usedInProducts.description: Administers member organizations, users, and entitlements across the network.
Manages shipper tenant organizations, roles, and access for support teams.
